tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search active (not expired) deals on Pechincha.ai, newest first, 25 per page. Each result has price and old price in BRL, discount %, store, coupon code if any, publication date and the deal page URL. Content is Brazilian Portuguese, so search in Portuguese: `query` matches a literal substring of th

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Full details of a deal: price and discount in BRL, store, coupon, purchase link, 30-day price history, product pros/cons, specs and FAQ. Markdown in Brazilian Portuguese.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: A product across stores: current offers with prices in BRL, lowest price, 30-day price stats, review summary, pros/cons, specs and FAQ. Markdown in Brazilian Portuguese.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Price history of a product, to judge whether a discount is real: min/avg/max in BRL, number of records and up to 30 dated prices. Says so when prices span fewer than 3 different days (not enough history to judge). Content in Brazilian Portuguese.

tools.name: check_product_url
tools.description: Check whether Pechincha.ai has an active deal for a product page URL from an online store. Returns the deal (price in BRL, discount, store, coupon, purchase link) and the lowest price across stores, or says there is none. Content in Brazilian Portuguese.

tools.name: list_store_coupons
tools.description: Active coupon codes of a store on Pechincha.ai. Content in Brazilian Portuguese.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Pechincha.ai categories as name (Brazilian Portuguese) and slug, for the category filter of search_deals.

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: Stores on Pechincha.ai as name and slug, for search_deals and list_store_coupons. There are 1000+ stores: pass `query` to filter by name.
